title: Streaming agent response states
user_prompt: Build the response panel for an assistant that receives text chunks from a caller-owned stream. It needs to show waiting, streaming, completed, empty, failed, and cancelled states. Let the user request cancellation and retry a failed run. The UI must reflect the execution state supplied by the caller and must not invent progress or initiate network requests itself.

acceptance_checks.assertion: Waiting, streaming, completed, empty, failed, and cancelled states render distinguishably from explicit state input.
acceptance_checks.evidence_required: Tests for all six state cases.

acceptance_checks.assertion: Progress indicators are grounded in real values or are explicitly indeterminate; elapsed time is not presented as completion percentage.
The component renders supplied chunks and state; transport, retries, and cancellation requests belong to the caller/service contract.
A late result from an older run cannot overwrite the currently selected/retried run.
acceptance_checks.evidence_required: Test or explicit generation/run identity guard.

hard_gates.failure_condition: The UI fabricates progress, tool success, or completion without authoritative state.
A cancel request is shown as confirmed cancellation before execution confirms it.
